---
title: dev
description: Bring a Composer application up entirely on this machine, with no cloud credentials.
url: /cli/dev
metaTitle: dev | Prisma 8 CLI
metaDescription: Complete reference for the prisma dev command, which runs a Prisma Composer application locally against local emulators for Prisma Compute and Prisma Postgres.
---

`dev` brings a [Prisma Composer](/composer) application up entirely on this machine. It takes an `<entry>` argument: the module whose default export is the application root, typically `module.ts`. The command runs credential-free against local emulators standing in for Prisma Compute and Prisma Postgres, watches the built output, and restarts a service when its build changes. See [Local development](/composer/local-development).

`dev` and [`deploy`](/cli/deploy) are root-level commands of the unified Prisma CLI. There is no `composer` command group. Like `deploy`, `dev` runs your *built* output, so build first.

## Usage

```npm
npx prisma@latest dev module.ts
npx prisma@latest dev module.ts --fresh
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--name <name>` | Override the application name for the local dev instance |
| `--fresh` | Destroy the dev stack and wipe the dev state directory before starting. In this release the flag fails for apps with a database; see [Local development](/composer/local-development#whats-local-vs-whats-real) for the manual reset |

`dev` needs no credentials or environment variables; local runs never talk to the platform.

To tail the running application's merged logs, use the `log` operation of the [control API](/cli/deploy#the-control-api); the unified CLI has no `log` command.

## Next steps

- [Local development](/composer/local-development): warm restarts, `--fresh`, and what persists.
- [`deploy`](/cli/deploy): the same application, on Prisma Compute.

2	title: db migrate
3	description: Apply pending Prisma 8 migrations.
4	url: /cli/db-migrate
5	metaTitle: db migrate | Prisma 8 CLI
6	metaDescription: Learn how to apply pending Prisma 8 on-disk migrations with the db migrate command.
7	---
8	
9	`db migrate` applies pending on-disk migrations to advance the database. It walks every contract space (app and extensions) and applies migrations in canonical order: extensions alphabetically, then the app. It applies only the migrations that exist on disk and never generates new operations.
10	
11	Use it from a controlled deployment step after reviewing migration packages.
12	
13	## Usage
14	
15	```npm
16	npx prisma@latest db migrate --db "$DATABASE_URL"
17	```
18	
19	## Options
20	
21	| Option | What it does |
22	| --- | --- |
23	| `--db <url>` | Connects to the database. |
24	| `--to <contract>` | Applies migrations up to a target contract (hash, prefix, ref name, migration directory name, `<dir>^`, or `./path`). |
25	| `--advance-ref <name>` | Advances the named [ref](/cli/migration-ref) to the post-apply marker after success. |
26	| `--show` | Previews the migration route without applying (read-only). |
27	| `--from <contract>` | Sets the from-state for the `--show` preview: `@contract` (the emitted contract), `@db` (the database's current marker), a hash, a ref name, or a migration directory. |
28	| `--config <path>` | Read this config file instead of `./prisma.config.ts`. |
29	| `--json` | Prints a machine-readable result. |
30	
31	## Recommended flow
32	
33	```npm
34	npx prisma@latest migration status --db "$DATABASE_URL"
35	npx prisma@latest db migrate --db "$DATABASE_URL"
36	npx prisma@latest migration status --db "$DATABASE_URL"
37	npx prisma@latest db verify --db "$DATABASE_URL"
38	```
39	
40	Run `migration status` before and after applying migrations to see what changed.
41	
42	## Previewing the route
43	
44	`--show` prints the route `db migrate` would take without touching the database:
45	
46	```npm
47	npx prisma@latest db migrate --show
48	npx prisma@latest db migrate --show --from @contract --to production
49	```
50	
51	## Applying to a target
52	
53	If your project uses named [refs](/cli/migration-ref), apply up to a target ref:
54	
55	```npm
56	npx prisma@latest db migrate --db "$DATABASE_URL" --to production
57	```
58	
59	Manage refs with [`migration ref`](/cli/migration-ref).
60

---
title: db migrate
description: Apply pending Prisma 8 migrations.
url: /cli/db-migrate
metaTitle: db migrate | Prisma 8 CLI
metaDescription: Learn how to apply pending Prisma 8 on-disk migrations with the db migrate command.
---

`db migrate` applies pending on-disk migrations to advance the database. It walks every contract space (app and extensions) and applies migrations in canonical order: extensions alphabetically, then the app. It applies only the migrations that exist on disk and never generates new operations.

Use it from a controlled deployment step after reviewing migration packages.

## Usage

```npm
npx prisma@latest db migrate --db "$DATABASE_URL"
```

## Options

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--db <url>` | Connects to the database. |
| `--to <contract>` | Applies migrations up to a target contract (hash, prefix, ref name, migration directory name, `<dir>^`, or `./path`). |
| `--advance-ref <name>` | Advances the named [ref](/cli/migration-ref) to the post-apply marker after success. |
| `--show` | Previews the migration route without applying (read-only). |
| `--from <contract>` | Sets the from-state for the `--show` preview: `@contract` (the emitted contract), `@db` (the database's current marker), a hash, a ref name, or a migration directory. |
| `--config <path>` | Read this config file instead of `./prisma.config.ts`. |
| `--json` | Prints a machine-readable result. |

## Recommended flow

```npm
npx prisma@latest migration status --db "$DATABASE_URL"
npx prisma@latest db migrate --db "$DATABASE_URL"
npx prisma@latest migration status --db "$DATABASE_URL"
npx prisma@latest db verify --db "$DATABASE_URL"
```

Run `migration status` before and after applying migrations to see what changed.

## Previewing the route

`--show` prints the route `db migrate` would take without touching the database:

```npm
npx prisma@latest db migrate --show
npx prisma@latest db migrate --show --from @contract --to production
```

## Applying to a target

If your project uses named [refs](/cli/migration-ref), apply up to a target ref:

```npm
npx prisma@latest db migrate --db "$DATABASE_URL" --to production
```

Manage refs with [`migration ref`](/cli/migration-ref).

This is a Prisma 8 CLI, and this doc set doesn't contain content on database auto-creation or a programmatic Client API for it (checked `cli/db-migrate.mdx` and `cli/dev.mdx` — neither covers this).

To answer directly: there's no Prisma Client API to create a database — Prisma Client only operates within the database named in the connection string. Your options are the CLI (`migrate dev`/`db push`, which issue `CREATE DATABASE` automatically) or running raw SQL yourself (e.g., connect to a default DB like `mysql`/`postgres` and execute `CREATE DATABASE` via `$executeRawUnsafe`, or use your driver directly) — there's no documented programmatic Prisma-specific method for this in this repo.
